correctness.rationale: For 28 geometric bitangents of a smooth nonhyperelliptic genus-three curve in characteristic !=2, the 288 seven-element Aronhold systems are modeled by odd quadratic refinements of F2^6 and the azygetic triple parity rule. Every heptad incidence column has sum 7, so its integer span is contained in the index-seven sum-congruence lattice. An explicit 28x28 submatrix of these 288 columns has exact integer determinant of absolute value 7, checked independently by constructing odd thetas, all 288 valid subsets and a fresh integer determinant; hence the column span has index exactly seven and its Smith invariants are 1^27,7. This is a formal incidence lattice, not a divisor-class assertion.
